milestones.title: Sign-on option for the npm registry reviewed

remediation: Verdaccio serves public packages only, with per-reader accounts whose passwords OpenBao generates, `promotion` as the only publisher, builds that fail closed when it is down and storage that can be rebuilt from Harbor's approved npm sets. Review a sign-on plugin, after its own fit check, or a replacement registry.
title: The npm registry signs readers in with its own accounts, not your organization's sign-on, and has no high availability
